::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
1. Penilaian individu terdiri dari **Kuis** (lewat Moodle, lihat halaman Jadwal untuk tanggalnya) dan **Proyek Individu** (dikerjakan berkelanjutan sepanjang semester, dinilai per milestone).
2. Milestone proyek individu akan muncul di menu ini satu per satu, seiring tutorial minggu terkait selesai dipublish.
3. Beberapa milestone punya **prasyarat tutorial** — perhatikan catatan prasyarat di setiap halaman milestone sebelum submit.
4. Apabila terdapat kesulitan, mahasiswa dapat bertanya kepada asisten dosen melalui media komunikasi yang sudah ditentukan.
:::
::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
1. Individual assessment consists of **Quizzes** (via Moodle, see the Schedule page for dates) and an **Individual Project** (worked on continuously throughout the semester, graded per milestone).
2. Individual project milestones will appear in this menu one at a time, as each related tutorial week is published.
3. Some milestones have a **tutorial prerequisite** — check the prerequisite note on each milestone page before submitting.
4. If you run into difficulties, students may ask teaching assistants questions through the designated communication channel.
:::
